nodes.label: Mobile Remote Controller (Smartphone Web Clicker)
nodes.rationale: No-app wireless control chosen so a presenter's phone needs only a QR scan or local URL; Socket.io sync for <10ms latency, 180ms debouncing against double-tap, haptic feedback, Screen Wake Lock to keep the phone alive during the pitch, and stopwatch telemetry segmented into 5-5-2 minute pacing phases.

nodes.label: Web Slide Presenter (Laptop/Projector)
nodes.rationale: High-resolution slide surface for projector display; 13 interactive business slides, GPU-accelerated kinetic animation, vendor supply-chain/BEP transparency, live profit calculator, and WCAG AAA/AA dual-theme (Dark Umber Earth / Warm Artisanal Linen) chosen because projector legibility and accessibility compliance were explicit requirements.
